appearance_facts.fact: A blue line with circular markers connects data points from left to right across the plot area, accompanied by a light blue shaded region beneath the line.

The line begins near the top-left corner of the plot area, remains relatively flat for the first several points, then slopes steeply downward to the right, continuing a gradual descent toward the bottom-right corner.
The y-axis is oriented with 0 at the top and 1400 at the bottom, meaning lower vertical positions on the screen correspond to higher numerical values.
The x-axis displays date labels from Jan 27, 2020 on the left to Mar 22, 2020 on the right, arranged chronologically from left to right.

printed_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Month vs. Number of cases'.
Y-axis label is 'Count' with tick values 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400 descending from top to bottom.
The first data point on Jan 27, 2020 is positioned at the top of the chart, corresponding to a count near 0.
The final data point on Mar 22, 2020 is positioned at the bottom of the chart, corresponding to a count near 1400.
Intermediate points show a steady increase in count values over time, such as ~300 on Mar 09, ~550 on Mar 10, ~750 on Mar 11, and ~1150 on Mar 18.
